name: Pi-hole FTL
param_style: SQLite C API: ? / ?N positional in the DNS hot path, :name in the REST API; /api/queries and list SQL assembled with snprintf
schema_source: gravity.db: test/gravity.db.sql (template copy, CREATE statements only); query DB: src/database/query-table.h CREATE_* macros and index_creation[]; network/aliasclient/message tables from src/database/network-table.c, aliasclients.c, message-table.c. Both databases are merged into one schema (no table names clash); disk_query_storage stands in for the ATTACHed disk.query_storage.
data_scale: scale 1: 100k query_storage rows over 7 days (90k copied into disk_query_storage), 6k domains, 60 client names, 4 upstreams, 300 addinfo; gravity 167k rows in 30 adlists, 2k antigravity, 3k domainlist, 62 clients, 9 groups; 300 network devices / 470 addresses; 60 messages
visibility_note: FTL is the engine of Pi-hole (~55k stars on pi-hole/pi-hole), one of the most widely deployed self-hosted apps; SQLite is its only storage (gravity.db + pihole-FTL.db + an in-memory query DB)
interest_note: Gravity lookups through LEFT-JOIN views with enabled/group predicates on every DNS cache miss; query log page with a 4-way join and string-built filters (LIKE, status IN lists, cursor); long-term stats with time-bucket GROUP BYs over derived tables; memory-to-disk export bounded by nested scalar MAX/MIN subqueries.
reach_note: the engine behind Pi-hole (umbrella repo pi-hole/pi-hole); hundreds of thousands of networks
